title: Alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#5B9BD5'/>
  <rect x='64' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#5B9BD5'/>
  <!-- bell left -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='26' r='11' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='26' r='7' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='18' y='33' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- bell right -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='11' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='26' r='7' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <rect x='70' y='33' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- hammer -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='#B0BEC5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='34' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='29' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='24' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <!-- hour marks -->
  <rect x='48' y='33' width='4' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='48' y='72' width='4' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='26' y='53' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='69' y='53' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x='47' y='45' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#455A64'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='48' y='36' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#37474F'/>
  <rect x='48' y='55' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#37474F'/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FF7043'/>
</svg>
